nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256 holding token balances of each account.
Nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 storing spending allowances.
Total number of minted tokens, increased by _mint and reduced by _burn.
ERC20 token name, set once in the ERC20 constructor.
ERC20 token symbol, set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Token decimals, defaults to 18 and only mutable through _setupDecimals.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address, used as the mint recipient in the MockERC20 constructor.
Context helper returning msg.sender; used as the caller identity by transfer/approve functions.
Public ERC20 transfer; moves amount from _msgSender() to recipient and returns true.
Public ERC20 approve; sets spender allowance for _msgSender().
Public ERC20 transferFrom; moves tokens on behalf of sender after reducing caller allowance.
Atomically increases the allowance granted to spender by the caller.
Atomically decreases the allowance granted to spender by the caller.
Internal transfer routine updating _balances and emitting Transfer; invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Internal mint routine increasing _totalSupply and the recipient balance; invokes the hook.
Internal burn routine decreasing the account balance and _totalSupply; invokes the hook.
Internal allowance setter writing to _allowances and emitting Approval.
Internal setter that overwrites _decimals; no access control on the internal call site.
Virtual hook invoked before every mint, burn and transfer; overridable in derived contracts.
MockERC20 constructor; initializes ERC20 metadata and mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
View function returning _balances[account].
View function returning _allowances[owner][spender].
View function returning _totalSupply.
Unbounded mint of the full supply to msg.sender inside the constructor with no cap or access restriction.
Subtraction/addition of balances and total supply in _transfer and _burn, guarded only by SafeMath.
Allowance subtraction/addition in transferFrom, increaseAllowance and decreaseAllowance, guarded by SafeMath.
Constructor parameter name string passed to ERC20 base constructor.
Constructor parameter symbol string passed to ERC20 base constructor.
Constructor parameter supply minted entirely to msg.sender.
sender address parameter of transferFrom and _transfer.
recipient address parameter of transfer/transferFrom/_transfer.
amount uint256 parameter of transfer, approve, transferFrom and _transfer.
spender address parameter of approve, _approve, increaseAllowance and decreaseAllowance.
owner address parameter of _approve whose allowance entry is written.
addedValue uint256 parameter of increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue uint256 parameter of decreaseAllowance.
account address parameter of _mint, _burn and balanceOf.
decimals_ uint8 parameter written into _decimals by _setupDecimals.

edges.reason: msg.sender, the deployer, is used as the sole mint recipient in the constructor, granting the entire supply without any access restriction.
_msgSender simply returns msg.sender.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of the token movement.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is reduced.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transfer delegates all balance work to _transfer.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
transferFrom delegates the token movement to _transfer.
transferFrom re-writes the spender allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance via _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance via _approve.
_transfer reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient.
_mint increases the recipient entry of _balances.
_burn decreases the account entry of _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_approve writes the owner/spender entry of _allowances.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
allowance reads _allowances[owner][spender].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
_setupDecimals overwrites the _decimals state variable.
The constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
The constructor performs an unrestricted mint of the full supply to the deployer via msg.sender.
_transfer performs subtraction and addition on balances and total supply, protected only by SafeMath.
_burn performs subtraction on the account balance and _totalSupply, protected only by SafeMath.
transferFrom subtracts the transferred amount from the stored allowance.
increaseAllowance adds addedValue to the current allowance.
decreaseAllowance subtracts subtractedValue from the current allowance.
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are settled, a reentrancy surface if overridden with external calls.
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook prior to supply and balance state changes.
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook prior to balance and supply state changes.
Constructor name parameter is forwarded to the ERC20 base constructor.
Constructor symbol parameter is forwarded to the ERC20 base constructor.
Constructor supply parameter is passed to _mint as the minted amount.
sender parameter supplies the debited account in _transfer.
recipient parameter supplies the credited account in _transfer.
amount parameter is the quantity moved by _transfer.
sender parameter is the account debited by transferFrom.
recipient parameter is the account credited by transferFrom.
amount parameter is passed into _transfer and the allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
amount parameter is the allowance value set by approve.
spender parameter is the allowance beneficiary set by approve.
spender parameter indexes the _allowances entry written by _approve.
owner parameter indexes the _allowances entry written by _approve.
addedValue parameter is added to the caller allowance.
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the caller allowance.
account parameter is the mint recipient in _mint.
account parameter is the burned account in _burn.
account parameter indexes the _balances read in balanceOf.
decimals_ parameter is written into the _decimals state variable.
